description: Hypothesis: 2048-token model batches, 64-row grouped expert tiles, predecoded dense projections and device FP16 TensorOps attention improve prefill over the fast-prefill base. Run --tuned-prefill with the same DFlash2 draft and prefix caching. FP32 accumulation, softmax, KV and recurrent state are retained; small speculative verification uses FP32 attention. Several kernels and batching change together, so improvements cannot be attributed to one change. The latest evaluator also disables thinking for needle; historical results are not a matched evaluation-revision comparison. The prefill goal reflects the requested further 5x over the prior formal 622.6 tok/s result.
